sources.summary: Official Luau organization repository hosting the Luau website and user-facing language documentation. Use as supplemental language context; Roblox Creator Hub remains authoritative for Roblox-specific API behavior.

Definition-based networking framework with namespacing, middleware concepts such as type checking/rate limiting/logging, and asynchronous networking patterns. The repository is supplemental architecture reference, not Roblox API authority.

Luau networking library centered on buffer serialization/deserialization and typed networking APIs. Use only as a practical networking reference; do not infer that its performance/security claims are universal.
IDL/compiler-oriented Luau networking project describing generated buffer networking, client-data validation, and bandwidth/CPU optimization goals. Treat claims as project-specific and supplemental.
